channel.title: Deep Quantum Science blog
channel.description: Quantum physics, AI and research, explained.

item.title: One machine, all the energies: perturbation theory with matrices
item.description: A compact matrix recursion gives every eigenvalue and eigenstate at once, to any order. We run it, and show exactly when and why it breaks.

item.title: Can a quantum system remember its past? Many-body localisation
item.description: Most systems forget where they started. With strong disorder, interacting quantum spins can refuse to. Three fingerprints, computed exactly.

item.title: How to build a Word ⇄ LaTeX converter: the design of DeepQ Manuscript
item.description: The architecture and the algorithms behind DeepQ Manuscript, explained step by step with figures and pseudocode. Free to read, reuse and build upon.

item.title: Quantum spins are just binary numbers
item.description: Read a chain of spins as a binary number, and spin operators become simple jumps between integers: the idea behind our Dirac representation.

item.title: Perturbation theory explained like you’re 10
item.description: Tiny magnets on a bumpy road: how physicists estimate energies when the exact problem is too hard, step by step and with real numbers.
